verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.mx.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to markdown pages (e.g. 'Products (152 pages)'). Doc pages are served as .md URLs throughout, which is directly agent-consumable. A documented MCP endpoint and a public OpenAPI spec on GitHub add further machine-readable surfaces. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-usage guidance, and no independent hands-on report of an agent actually using these docs.
